hooks.name: Inject previous session context
hooks.description: Load relevant context from previous sessions when a new session starts

action.prompt: A new session has started. Check if the Total Recall MCP server is available. If so, use the get_context tool to retrieve previous session context for this project. Use this context to understand where we left off and any decisions previously made.

hooks.name: Save session summary on stop
hooks.description: Persist session summary to Total Recall when session ends

action.prompt: The session is ending. If Total Recall MCP is available, use save_memory to store a structured summary of what was accomplished in this session: files changed, decisions made, and next steps. This ensures continuity in the next session.
